cd /workspace/tmp && cat > rssdrive.py <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.util, json, resource, sys, io, os
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("sub","/workspace/submission/main.py")
sub=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)
path=sys.argv[1]; cp=sys.argv[2]=="1"
reqs=[]; t=0
for f in range(4096): reqs.append({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0})
per=1000000//4096
for f in range(4096):
    sent=0
    while sent<per:
        ch=[]
        for _ in range(min(1024,per-sent)):
            t+=1; ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":t%2,"length":1+((t*7919)%2048)}); sent+=1
        reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})
if cp: reqs.append({"op":"checkpoint"})
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs)
class FakeIn(io.RawIOBase):
    def __init__(self,s): self.buf=s.encode(); self.pos=0
    def readable(self): return True
    def readinto(self,b):
        n=min(len(b),len(self.buf)-self.pos)
        if n<=0: return 0
        b[:n]=self.buf[self.pos:self.pos+n]; self.pos+=n; return n
sys.stdin = io.TextIOWrapper(io.BufferedReader(FakeIn(data)), encoding="utf-8")
# patch: main uses sys.stdin.buffer
class TW(io.TextIOWrapper):
    pass
sys.stdin.buffer = FakeIn(data)
out = open(os.devnull,"wb")
sys.stdout = io.TextIOWrapper(out)
sys.stdout.buffer = out
rc = sub.do_stream(path)
sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
sys.stderr.write("rss=%.1fMB rc=%d\n"%(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024,rc))
PYEOF
python3 rssdrive.py /tmp/nonexist 2>&1 | head -2 || true

 {'version':1,'idle_timeout':10**9,'packet_limit':10**9,'prefix_width':32,

          [{'id':i,'class':2,'priority':1,'ranges':[[0,0]]} for i in range(1,2048)],
  'fallback':{'feature':0,'threshold':0,'le':{'class':1},'gt':{'class':2}}}).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout)
open('$D/p.json','w').write(json.dumps(prog))
print('$D/p.json')"
